selection: Existing V0.3 only: average reciprocal-rank evidence within each modality, then RRF of modality asset ranks. No asset allowlist or GT.
speech_peak_collapse: existing speech_search.query.collapse: start difference<=2s or overlap>=50% of shorter interval
anchor_selection: Left-to-right reference segments; shortest available HIGH 1/2/3-segment query, otherwise single MEDIUM; LOW skipped. Non-overlapping segment IDs. All39 queries still searched and saved.
caution: Ordinal evidence scores and coverage are heuristics, not probabilities or ground truth. A forced monotone weak match cannot pass HIGH. Thresholds are not tuned on this reference.
output: Recognition diagnostics only; no edit timeline, video decode, clipping, source embedding recomputation, FAISS creation or global FAISS search.
